historical_limits.reason: fixed_json returned its parsed dict only in RAM; backup_preflight checks it as one conjunction and raises without recording fixed per-field outcomes. The process record proves successful SQL transport, not which value check failed.

source_findings.fact: The conjunction requires archive_mode off AND current_setting(archive_command) empty. Under exact PG17.11, off selects the nonempty fixed display sentinel (disabled). Other archive modes fail the explicit off conjunct. Thus this conjunction cannot pass its required mode.

source_findings.fact: One assertion combines exact field set,16 actual-True booleans and lower-hex64 system-ID hash shape; no comparison receipt is persisted before raising. The successful process leaves its failed individual check unknowable.

PG17_primary_references.fact: show_config_by_name obtains its text through GetConfigOptionByName.
GetConfigOptionByName delegates to ShowGUCOption, whose string branch invokes a configured show hook.
archive_command is PGC_SIGHUP with an empty default and show_archive_command hook. archive_mode defaults to OFF.
show_archive_command returns the fixed display sentinel (disabled) while archiving is inactive.

pg_settings.setting also uses ShowGUCOption, so substituting setting would retain the bug. Its string reset_val is copied directly from the underlying reset_val member rather than the display hook. context is separately exposed from the GUC context name.
